name: soak
description: Plan 11.4: six hours on the wan50 profile with the S1 production configuration. Continuous churn of 20 streams/s (10 kB-1 MB, log-uniform), 10 long-lived streams and a bulk burst every five minutes, with a 64-byte latency probe alongside. RSS, VmHWM, CPU, fd count and the SNMP CurrEstab session count are sampled every 60 s; acceptance is a flat RSS and fd slope after warm-up. It runs on the PRODUCTION closewait default (server 30 s), not closewait 0: that 30 s linger is exactly the mechanism most likely to accumulate descriptors, so removing it would test the wrong thing. At 20 streams/s it is a legitimate steady state of ~600 descriptors per side, which the host's 1024 soft limit cannot hold - so lab-start.sh raises OUR OWN soft limit to 65536 instead (no privilege needed, hard limit is 1048576, nothing outside our processes is affected). Acceptance is a flat PLATEAU, not a low number. See DECISIONS D28.
